name: Priya
purpose: Find fellowships, funding deadlines and maybe people outside her lab — on her laptop between experiments.
backstory: I live in my lab. I'd like to know about fellowships and travel grants before the deadline instead of hearing about them a week late, and honestly it would be nice to meet people who aren't in my research group. I'm allergic to apps that treat me like an undergrad.
quitsWhen: Mobile-only layout stretched on my laptop
voice: Precise, a little dry. Notices sloppy details. 'This deadline is wrong', 'Why is this here?'
